chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Whoever remembers Allah, Mighty and Exalted, in the marketplaces, He will forgive him by the number of their people.

key_terms.أَهْلِهَا: the people present in the marketplaces
key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.اَللَّهَ: Allah, the One remembered and worshipped

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for remembering Allah in the marketplace?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great merit of dhikr in places of worldly distraction such as marketplaces. It emphasizes that remembering Allah عزّ وجلّ in such environments is a cause of immense forgiveness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3756 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever remembers Allah (swt), the Mighty and Exalted, in the marketplaces, Allah (swt) will forgive him by the number of its people."
